_COMMENT_FILE_PATH: SAVE THIS FILE AS: config_dryrun_telegram.json — in the ROOT of your NostalgiaForInfinity repo (same folder as NostalgiaForInfinityX7.py, README.md, docker-compose.yml). NOT inside user_data/, NOT inside configs/.
_COMMENT_purpose: Dry-run only — no real orders are ever placed (dry_run: true). This simulates trades using live market data and sends Telegram notifications on every simulated entry/exit, exactly like real trading, but with zero capital at risk. Do not flip dry_run to false without a separate, deliberate review.
_COMMENT_restart_architecture: This runs under a self-queueing GitHub Actions chain (~5h45m per session), with a periodic hourly WAL-checkpoint+push in between so state doesn't wait a full session to sync (see dry-run-telegram-signals.yml). db_url below IS the real, active connection (local SQLite) — persisted across restarts via a dedicated git branch (state-spot).
_COMMENT_exchange_switch: Switched from KuCoin to OKX on 2026-09-14 — SAME exchange as the futures bot now, specifically so the new dashboard 'Signal Overlap' analysis (does a spot long entry fire on futures too, and vice versa) isn't confounded by comparing two different exchanges' price/volume data. This was a deliberate reset of spot's dry-run history (minimal cost — under 2 days of data collected on KuCoin at the time of the switch).
_COMMENT_position_adjustment: NostalgiaForInfinityX7 requires position_adjustment_enable=true for its Grinding V2 and Buyback systems to function (per the strategy's own documentation) — without this, the strategy behaves in ways its author never intended/tested.

exchange.name: okx
exchange._COMMENT_password: OKX's API requires a passphrase (the 'password' field) in addition to key/secret. Left empty here since dry-run never calls authenticated endpoints for real trading — only public market-data endpoints are used to simulate trades.

_COMMENT_pairlist: Same filter chain as before (matches NostalgiaForInfinity's own official pairlist-volume config). lookback_days=1 added to both VolumePairList entries — required for OKX (its live-ticker data doesn't expose quoteVolume in the format VolumePairList defaults to, so it must use candle-based/advanced-mode volume calculation instead; this was already confirmed necessary for the futures OKX config).
_COMMENT_telegram: token/chat_id below are dummy placeholders satisfying the config schema's required fields. The REAL values are injected at runtime via FREQTRADE__TELEGRAM__TOKEN / FREQTRADE__TELEGRAM__CHAT_ID environment variables (sourced from GitHub Secrets in the workflow) — never commit real credentials into this file.
_COMMENT_db_url: This IS the real, active db_url now (local SQLite) — no env var override. The workflow restores this file from the state-spot branch before starting freqtrade, and saves it back after each session (plus an hourly mid-session checkpoint push).
